## Highlights since 0.6.0

- **Undo and redo work again.** ⌘Z and ⇧⌘Z reach every editor again, and Edit ▸ Undo and Redo step the focused editor's own history, including Enter, completions, brackets and paste. Both had been broken since v0.1.239.
- **Comment cards that answer in place.** A comment's card on the source is redrawn as the collaboration panel's thread card: Resolve is a check that confirms the result and offers Undo, and Reply is an inline field under the thread. Comments on the PDF get a hover preview and the same card on click. The note composer drops its Esc button; Esc or a press outside closes it, and a discarded note can be brought back with Undo.
- **Menus close where you expect.** A press beside any menu, select or context menu only closes it instead of moving the caret, jumping the PDF or reaching an iframe, and pressing a menu's button again closes it. Menus, selects and popovers in the Agent panel and in Settings → Models / MCP / Skills now close on a press anywhere else in Lattice too.

## Notable fixes

- Settings → Appearance gives the Color theme and Tint tiles more room, and a selected tile's ring no longer touches its name.
- Tab close buttons are a 22 × 22 square inset from the tab's edges on every tab strip.
